summary: BitFuFu Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 10, 2026, reporting its unaudited Bitcoin production and operational metrics for June 2026. The disclosure includes operational highlights such as Bitcoin held (1,671 BTC), production (125 BTC), total hashrate (15.3 EH/s), and power capacity (273 MW). It also notes the acquisition of 1,200 S21 XP units and signed agreements for 2,000 additional units, alongside a nine-month hashrate agreement for 5.3 EH/s. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No deal terms or strategic corporate event is present.
